nodes.label: Ember Social Ordered Roadmap (Everest sprint priority)
nodes.rationale: Each step is a self-contained file with a copy-paste DeepSeek/GLM prompt and acceptance criteria; steps must run in order within a phase; the Everest Motoring 4-day sprint compresses the highest-value items to get the first 30-day plan signed off.
nodes.norm_label: ember social ordered roadmap (everest sprint priority)

nodes.label: Publish Spine (trigger -> approve -> cron -> FB publish)
nodes.rationale: The core hard rule of the codebase: every content feature must flow through the existing trigger -> approval -> Vercel cron -> platform publish pipeline and must never break it.
nodes.norm_label: publish spine (trigger -> approve -> cron -> fb publish)

nodes.label: Slug-vs-UUID Trap (resolveWorkspaceId)
nodes.rationale: Workspace URLs accept UUID or slug but every table stores the UUID; browser queries filtering workspace_id by the route param silently return zero rows — pages must call an API route that uses resolveWorkspaceId().

nodes.label: Supabase Client Selection Rules (server/admin/browser)
nodes.rationale: createServerSupabaseClient for user-session server code, createAdminClient (service role) for webhooks/cron/trusted server-only code, browser anon client only for RLS-scoped queries.

nodes.label: Unified Brand + Social History Intake (Day 1)
nodes.rationale: The site scan captures the brand's aspiration; the social history scan captures reality (cadence, top themes, best hours) — both must feed the campaign generator before a research-backed plan is possible.

nodes.label: Smart Campaign Generator + Per-Platform Variants (Day 2)
nodes.rationale: Generates a 30-day plan from scanned data with FB/IG/TikTok variants and a strategy_rationale explaining frequency/timing; posts persist as pending_approval so they flow through the existing publish spine.

nodes.label: Client Review Portal /plan/<token> + PDF Export (Day 3)
nodes.rationale: Per-post comments, change-requests, bulk approval and a brand-coloured PDF turn plan revisions from email threads into one shareable artefact — the feature that makes Ember an agency platform.

nodes.label: Per-Platform Composer Previews + IG First Comment (Day 4)
nodes.norm_label: per-platform composer previews + ig first comment (day 4)

nodes.label: Inventory-Aware Campaign Variants (Day 5 original, superseded)
nodes.rationale: Pulled real vehicles from Everest's cars table into campaign posts with real photos; superseded by the revised Day 5 because the per-car catalogue approach duplicated Everest's existing trigger flow.

nodes.label: AI Lifestyle Images + Branded Overlay (Day 5 revised)
nodes.rationale: Campaign posts are lifestyle/educational brand-building content, not per-car sales posts; images generated with Gemini 2.5 Flash Image informed by inventory segments, logo top-left + workspace badge via sharp.
nodes.norm_label: ai lifestyle images + branded overlay (day 5 revised)

nodes.label: Migration 005: posts.last_error (manual SQL)
nodes.rationale: publish.ts already writes last_error; without the column in production every UPDATE fails and posts stay stuck in 'publishing' — the most likely root cause of the missed Everest auto-post.

nodes.label: Surface Campaign Generator in Workspace UI (A2)
nodes.norm_label: surface campaign generator in workspace ui (a2)

nodes.label: Real Engagement Data in post_results (A3)
nodes.rationale: Every downstream smart feature (feedback loop, predictive scoring) requires real performance data; Vercel Hobby caps at 2 crons, so the analytics refresh may need folding into publish-scheduled.

nodes.label: Real Inbox via Meta Webhooks (A4, messages table)
nodes.norm_label: real inbox via meta webhooks (a4, messages table)

nodes.label: Brand Voice Inference from Existing FB/IG Posts (B1)
nodes.norm_label: brand voice inference from existing fb/ig posts (b1)

nodes.label: TikTok / YouTube / LinkedIn Publishers (B2)
nodes.rationale: These platforms appear in the selector but silently no-op in publish.ts today; blocked on per-platform OAuth app approval.

nodes.label: GBP Local-Post Publishing Wiring (B3)
nodes.rationale: gbp.ts OAuth + createLocalPost already exist; only the dispatcher branch in publish.ts is missing, but it is blocked until Google approves GBP API access.

nodes.label: AI Inbox Triage + Guarded Auto-Reply (C1)
nodes.rationale: AI auto-replies only for high-confidence FAQ-class messages (price, hours, location); leads are human-routed with a suggested reply; must respect Meta's 24-hour DM policy.

nodes.label: Engagement Feedback Loop (C2)
nodes.rationale: client_intelligence is what the client says their voice is; post_results is what their audience actually responds to — feeding the latter back into generation is what makes the platform learn.

nodes.label: Everest July 2026 Premium Lifestyle Content Plan
nodes.rationale: Feed must feel premium and lifestyle-led (show where the cars take you, not the price box); July = Mpumalanga mid-winter dry season (Kruger, Panorama Route, school holidays); warm editorial grade, headline restraint, yellow accent as a whisper; runs through the six-template system (lifestyle_hero, studio, spec_card, multi_car, tip_card, sell_yours).
nodes.norm_label: everest july 2026 premium lifestyle content plan

nodes.label: YouTube Family Reel Upload Package (2026-07-06)
nodes.rationale: Vertical 9:16 <60s upload is auto-classified as a YouTube Short, which gets the best reach for a dealership — preferred over the landscape version.
